description: Siemens S7-1500 PLC Modbus register map (VERIFIED)
notes: CRITICAL: NO native system registers exposed via Modbus. Only user-defined data in MB_HOLD_REG exposed. Max holding registers: Array[0..65535] of Word. Requires TCON_IP_v4 structure for connection.

example_db_word_0.description: Example: DB.DBW0 mapped to 40001 (user must create)

example_real_value.description: Example: 32-bit float at 40101-40102 (user must create and map)

tcon_ip_v4_structure.InterfaceID: HW_ANY - Hardware ID of PROFINET interface
tcon_ip_v4_structure.RemoteAddress: ARRAY[1..4] of BYTE - Client IP (0.0.0.0 = accept any)

cycle_time_access.returns: OB1 cycle time, OB execution times, communication processing time
cycle_time_access.modbus_exposure: Must copy RT_INFO results to holding register DB for Modbus access

configuration_requirements: Use TCON_IP_v4 structure for connection description
ConnectionType = 11, ActiveEstablished = False for TCP server
Data block must use Standard access mode (not Optimized)
MB_UNIT_ID in instance DB static section (default 255)

_source_verified: Verified: MB_SERVER/MB_CLIENT confirmed; same SIOS 102020340 document covers S7-1200/1500
